answer: A proposed field-data exchange pays from a buyer-funded request, not per agent key: one sparrow drone image must match a shale assay and a delta site ID signed by an independent lab. Validators consume each prepaid request once; absent lab proof or replay forfeits payment. A farm can share one model and self-buy requests with borrowed cash, but that merely returns its own deposit minus a burned lab fee. Every extra profitable clone needs another outside buyer budget; loans cannot fabricate outside demand.
